measured_decisions.decision: pairPreference = 0.2 granularity term inside the assignment minimizer only
measured_decisions.reason: Measured: whole-line span blobs beat per-fragment matches because text distance averages local differences over longer strings — three duplicate occurrences surfaced all-ambiguous. The preference keeps one_to_one granularity ahead while split/merge still wins when its pair cost dominates. Recorded in experiment-granularity.md (E-T12-1).

measured_decisions.decision: margin = min(non-crossing re-solve, bounded local exchanges conflicting with <=2 chosen pairs)
measured_decisions.reason: Measured: the non-crossing model alone floors margins at the granularity preference, so the spec's 'tie' abstention could never fire (E-T12-2). Exchanges let a displaced fragment rematch or stay unmatched — a real competing assignment — while crossing solutions are still never accepted as unique.

measured_decisions.decision: normalization wraps the contract normalize() rather than re-implementing collapse
measured_decisions.reason: Views produced here must be byte-for-byte the contract views the report validator recomputes; this module adds index conversion, raw-slice recovery and integrity checking instead of a second collapse implementation.
